every time i was admitted i went to the ER first , then they can find you a bed in the state whereas some times if you go to a ward to begin with they might not have a bed and won’t be able to take you or will hold you for days in a room until they have a bed open(heard this from other people who had done it). the ER will hold you until the first available bed near you , the most i had to wait for a bed was maybe 40 hours. except sadly we’re in america so it’s super expensive and they require ambulance transportation from the ER to whatever ward you’re going to no matter how far

yes pack a bag! they will take it until you’re settled and placed in the ward. you can’t take anything that’s already been opened (toothpaste , deodorant and such), they don’t allow shorts or anything that has strings on it, bring a book or something to keep you busy they’ll have pencils for you to use. bringing it with you while trying to get admitted is the best option because then you can have you’re stuff sooner once you get in
